success.help_root:
Usage:
  ptc validate MANIFEST.json|PROJECT.json [--host-config HOST.json]
  ptc run MANIFEST.json|PROJECT.json [OPTIONS]
  ptc doctor [MANIFEST.json|PROJECT.json] [--host-config HOST.json] [--connect]
  ptc models PROJECT.json | --host-config HOST.json
  ptc init DIRECTORY
  ptc transcript RUN_ID --traces DIRECTORY --inspection DIRECTORY --private-unattended --private-output FILE
  ptc repl [OPTIONS] [SCRIPT|-]
  ptc serve GATEWAY.json
  ptc viewer PROJECT.json [--port PORT] [--listen ADDRESS]
  ptc --version

Options:
  --help    — show root help
  --version — show the command version
success.help_run:
Usage:
  ptc run MANIFEST.json|PROJECT.json [OPTIONS]

Options:
  --host-config HOST.json                         — trusted provider installation document
  --input INPUT.json                              — normal alternate input object
  --private-input INPUT.json                      — private alternate input object
  --trace-dir DIRECTORY                           — existing directory for the run-reference trace artifact
  --output VALUE.json                             — normal result artifact
  --private-output VALUE.json                     — owner-only private result artifact
  --inspect RUN.inspection.jsonl                  — owner-only private inspection artifact
  --component-override-descriptor DESCRIPTOR.json — verified replacement component descriptor
  --env-file FILE                                 — load environment variables from this exact file
  --envelope ENVELOPE.json                        — atomically publish the V2 command envelope
  --help                                          — show help for this command
